Markdown and React

You can write normal .md files or the more powerful .mdx format.

Use MDX to import and use React components inside your Markdown file:

import Callout from 'nextra-theme-docs/callout'

Code Highlighting

Code highlighting with focused lines using

```jsx highlight=2,3
function App() {
  // these 2 lines will be highlighted
  return <App>My JSX Code</App>
}
```

import useSWR from 'swr'

function Profile() {
  const { data, error } = useSWR('/api/user', fetcher)

  if (error) return <div>failed to load</div>
  if (!data) return <div>loading...</div>
  return <div>hello {data.name}!</div>
}

Inline code: let x = 1.
Multiple lines: x += 1.
